summary: Float exponents incorrectly used the integer parser, which consumes only the first zero of a zero-prefixed exponent and leaves trailing digits unparsed. The fix permits an optional sign followed by zero-prefixable digits. A verbatim reversal is available, but test selection is blocked: the fix enables valid/float/zero.toml through the custom decoder_compliance harness, without a corresponding named Rust test. Existing named float tests do not exercise zero-prefixed exponents. No builds or tests were run.
